page_title: AST 0-1 EVE | Aston Villa v Everton 18/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Tony Harrington has a clear sight and sees a foul from Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa).
90+1' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Beto (Everton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
84' Substitution. Thierno Barry is replaced by Beto (Everton).
82' George Hemmings (Aston Villa) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tony Harrington saw the whole situation.
80' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
78' George Hemmings (Aston Villa) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
78' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. James Garner (Everton) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch.
77' Tony Harrington couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) and blew his whistle.
75' Harrison Armstrong (Everton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
74' The linesman signals that Merlin Rohl (Everton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
74' Jordan Pickford leaps to intercept the corner kick from Matty Cash (Aston Villa).
74' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
73' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
73' Here is a change. Lamare Bogarde is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to George Hemmings (Aston Villa).
73' Ian Maatsen comes off the pitch to be replaced by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa).

73' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the top right corner, but Jordan Pickford pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
72' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
70' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
67' Rough tackle by Merlin Rohl (Everton). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
59' 0 - 1 What a goal that is! Thierno Barry (Everton) gets to the ball inside the box and brilliantly lifts the ball over Emiliano Martinez and into the net. 0:1.

59' Dwight McNeil (Everton) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the left side of the target, but Emiliano Martinez pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
58' It looks like Matty Cash (Aston Villa) saw red with that tackle. Tony Harrington won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
56' Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
52' The ball is cleared after Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
51' What a miss! The corner finds Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just over the bar.
50' This shall not pass! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
49' Jack Grealish (Everton) makes a rough challenge and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Flag up against Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
47' Yellow card. James Garner (Everton) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Everton take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Jack Grealish (Everton) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
43' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Matty Cash (Aston Villa). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
43' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) swings in a cross from the corner, but Jordan Pickford reads it well and gathers the ball. Aston Villa earn a corner.
42' Evann Guessand (Aston Villa) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
38' Aston Villa quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

37' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper. The linesman makes the right call and Aston Villa will have a corner.
36' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
35' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Everton players look gutted.
33' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jake O'Brien (Everton) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
33' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by James Garner (Everton).

32' That was a nice football moment. Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the roof of the net. Emiliano Martinez guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
31' Evann Guessand (Aston Villa) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
29' Dwight McNeil (Everton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
27' Aston Villa hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
24' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
23' Dwight McNeil (Everton) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
23' Jack Grealish (Everton) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
22' Dwight McNeil (Everton) will take a corner kick.

21' Thierno Barry (Everton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Everton force a corner. They send men into the box.
21' Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
19' James Garner (Everton) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
18' John McGinn is substituted due to injury. Unai Emery gives a chance to Evann Guessand (Aston Villa).
18' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
17' It doesn’t look good for John McGinn (Aston Villa); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
13' Dangerous play by Merlin Rohl (Everton). Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
8' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
7' James Garner (Everton) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Emiliano Buendia sprays a pass out to Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar.
4' Dwight McNeil (Everton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tony Harrington no option but to blow his whistle.
1' Merlin Rohl (Everton) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the left post!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Everton will kick the game off.
Tony Harrington will supervise the game today.
